provider: Codex CLI using existing ChatGPT login
controls: ignore user config; disable shell_tool, unified_exec, apps, plugins, remote_plugin and tool_suggest; stop on an unexpected tool; workspace-write in empty host directory, ephemeral fresh processes; pilot repo worker and sandbox are assigned per arm
reviewPolicy: Blind both arms after all available results; retain missing reviews and disagreements. No hidden retry of an ambiguous model call.
selection: Audit selected after observing a memory write in its second session; this adaptive follow-up is not a new independent task.
prompt: Before adopting the earlier audit fix, review it against the available source, history and fixed tests. Report what is supported and any unresolved issue.
